name: Herdr
description: Drive Codex, Claude Code and other coding agents running in Herdr panes: list agents, send prompts from chat, read output, and get woken up when an agent finishes or needs input.

language.description: Language of the plugin's own replies and watch notifications: en (English, default) or es (Spanish). Pane ids, names, paths, command syntax and agent output are never translated.

socketPath.description: Herdr server socket. Defaults to $HERDR_SOCKET_PATH or ~/.config/herdr/herdr.sock.

requestTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for one Herdr request. Defaults to 5000.

watchTimeoutMinutes.description: Ceiling for a watch that never settles. Defaults to 720.

readLines.description: Lines of pane output included in notifications and /herdr read. Defaults to 40.

herdrBin.description: herdr executable. Defaults to herdr on PATH.

sshBin.description: ssh executable used for remote machine transport. Defaults to ssh on PATH.

enabled.description: Whether remote machines are discovered/reachable at all. Defaults to true.

allowSend.description: Machine labels or profile ids (e.g. "buildbox") allowed to receive prompts/key presses. Defaults to an empty list.
